title: After 4 straight nights of not being able to remember dreams (or thinking that I haven't dreamt at all), I am finally back to Mall World.
content: This time, I was going to a food court area ("cafeteria") with childhood classmates of mine. For some reason, the mall was filled with escalators and for some reason, the mall combined itself with a type of school. I don't think I ever had this type of experience before. Not to mention that my classmates were complaining that video games nowadays are a lot of worse than it used to be back during the PS2 era. For some reason, I separated from my class, and I ended up going to the restroom aisle instead. The restroom area/ lobby was cleaner than usual, and I walked into the unisex restroom area. I don't know why, but all I remember from there is that the unisex restroom door was very narrow (width wise) to enter there. Once I entered there, I just completely woke up. I don't know why, but I do wonder, what's inside the food that is inside the Mall area? Why are "daycare/ school teachers" leading us to the cafeteria? Could there be some type of sauce within the food that leads one to forget one's own dreams? Why am I back to Mall World after a series of nights that I cannot remember anything at all?
